reuse.why: Introduces one isHoliday predicate in shared/schedules.ts and routes all four existing holiday checks (getNextDate twice, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getDatesInRange) through it.

duplication.why: The matching rule is written once; every caller still converts with dayFromDate before calling isHoliday, a small repetition the predicate could have absorbed.

placement.why: The predicate sits in shared/schedules.ts with the other date/holiday helpers and is imported by the server app like the existing helpers.

scope.why: Focused on the holiday match plus tests; the getDatesInRange condition was reindented in a way that does not match the surrounding formatting.

maintainability.why: A single small predicate owns the holiday-matching rule, which is easy to own; the input is an untyped date string, so callers must keep slicing it to YYYY-MM-DD themselves.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No holiday check is left as a raw `holidays.includes`.
